description: Source code implementing ASN.1 integer and enumerated type serialization functions for OpenSSL, specifically for converting ASN1_INTEGER and ASN1_ENUMERATED types to a textual representation using BIO.

methods.name: i2a_ASN1_INTEGER
methods.description: Converts ASN1_INTEGER to a textual representation and writes it to BIO.

methods.name: i2a_ASN1_ENUMERATED
methods.description: Converts ASN1_ENUMERATED to a textual representation by calling i2a_ASN1_INTEGER.
